artboards.title: V4 All in one — your code
V4 All in one — their code

annotations.text:
Shared — what doesn't change across variations.

The entry is one new row in the existing Invite sheet. "Have a code?" takes a friend code as well as a group code.

A Friend is a full member of your Circle: same status ring, same Nudge, same Feed updates and Amen. Where a co-member's update names the shared group, a Friend's says "Friend". The Friends chip sits beside the group chips; there is no separate Friends screen.

V1 — Friend code.

An 8-character personal code, read aloud or texted. It goes into the same "Enter a code" field as a 6-character group code — the length tells them apart, so the person never has to know which kind they were handed.

Cheapest to build: no camera, no deep links.

V2 — QR.

For people in the same room. "My code" and "Scan" are two halves of one screen. The QR encodes the same personal code as V1.

Needs a camera permission and a scanner package (none in pubspec today).

V3 — Invite link.

For people who aren't nearby. One button into the system share sheet; the recipient lands on a single confirm screen.

Depends on deep links, still deferred in #785. Opening the link with the app not installed has to survive the store round-trip.

V4 — All in one.

The same code shown three ways on one screen: QR, typed code, link. The add side puts the scanner and the code field together, so whatever they were given, it goes in one place.

Cost is the sum of V1–V3.
